content: Rawiri Wetitsawe hamatɨa

Merikɨtsɨ kepauka taxarita maye'a te'aitamete memayekɨkakai meheuyukwiyuka, Rawiri Kuhawi kaniutanɨ'ani kuyaxi wa'ukiyari, yunaime kuyaxi 'ixaheritsixi wahetsɨa miemete 'amunitsixi memɨwatakwinikɨ meta Xawaha kiekariyari warie memayaxetɨkɨnekɨ. Peru Rawiri Kerutsareme kiekariyaritsie kaneyuhayewa.
Hikɨ heiwa 'utaikaikaku Rawiri yu'itaritsie 'anukukeka, yuparatsiyu heima kaniuyeikakaitɨni, manapaitɨ 'uyeikatɨ 'ukaratsi kaniuxeiya 'ɨwaneme. 'Ukaratsi kwinimieme katini'ɨimarikaitɨni.
Rawiri katiniutanɨ'ani kemɨ'ane mɨhɨkɨtɨkai timaimɨtɨ, hikɨ mɨpaɨ katiniutaxatɨarieni: «Wetitsawe kanihɨkɨtɨni, 'Eriyani niweya meta 'Uriyaxi 'ɨyaya heti tewiyari».

Hikɨ Rawiri katiniuta'aita hetsɨana mɨ'atɨarienikɨ, kepauka Wetitsawe mɨ'atɨarie mɨkɨ hamatɨana kaniukahuni. 'Ariketa yukie kaneyani. Wetitsawe pɨkareutewikai 'akuxi xuriya mita'axiyakaitsie 'uyu'itieka,
hikɨ 'ayumieme kaniutihukata meta Rawiri katiniutaxatɨani mɨpaɨ mɨtimaikakɨ.
Hikɨ Rawiri Kuhawi 'ikɨ niuki kanenɨ'airieni: «'Uriyaxi heti tewiyari kenenanɨ'airi». Kuhawi mɨpaɨ katiniuyurieni.
Kepauka 'Uriyaxi munua, Rawiri kanita'iwawiya Kuhawi kemɨreyurienekai meta kuyaxi kememɨtehe'uximayakai meheyukwitɨwetɨ.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨta katinitahɨawe: «'Akie kenemie 'a'ɨya hamatɨa kenekahu'i». Kepauka mɨwayetɨa paratsiyuta, 'Uriyaxi 'imikieri katiniyetuiriyarieni ti'aitame yatiuta'aitaku.
Peru 'Uriyaxi yukie pɨkahetɨa matsi paratsiyu kitenie, kuyaxi ti'aitame hɨwemete wahamatɨa pukaatei.
Hikɨ Rawiri yakatinetimani 'Uriyaxi yukie mɨkahetɨakɨ, mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya: —'Ateewa pepeyetɨa. ¿Ketitayari 'akie pekaretɨa?

'Uriyaxi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Kakaɨyari tɨratuya kakuniyari meta yunaitɨ kuyaxi 'ixaheritsixi meta Kura kiekatari 'ixuriki xamaruyaritɨa yeuta mekanekuteni, meta neti'aitɨwame Kuhawi metatsiere 'iparewiwametemama, 'aixɨa pɨka'ane ne nekiita nemɨye'ani witsinemɨtiukwa'ani meta ne'ɨya hamatɨa ne'ukahuputɨ. Yurikɨ Ti'aitame hɨxie ne mɨpaɨ nekanaineni nepɨkayɨwe mɨpaɨ nemɨyɨaneni.
Rawiri mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Aixɨa kani'aneni, hikɨ 'ena keneuyuhayewa, 'uxa'ake nepɨmatsi'anunɨ'ani 'a'utɨma. 'Uriyaxi mɨkɨ tukaritsie Kerutsareme kaniyuhayewa. Hikɨ 'uxa'arieka,
Rawiri 'ikwai 'ixɨarariyaripa kanita'inieni hikɨ mana kanititawaitɨani. Peru mɨyatɨtɨ yaxeikɨa 'Uriyaxi yukie pɨkahetɨa matsi yaxeikɨa kuyaxi tehɨwemete mematihipitetsie 'ukaitɨ kaniukatariyarieni.
Hikɨ 'uxa'arieka ximeri Rawiri Kuhawi xapa kaniuta'utɨirieni, 'Uriyaxi 'utɨma kaneinɨ'ani.
Xapa mɨpaɨ payetainekai: «'Uriyaxi kenanuyeyetsa, hakewa matsi waɨkawa memeyukwitɨwetsie. Hikɨ yuxaɨtame xekenehayewa metsekienikɨ meta memierienikɨ».
'Ayumieme kepauka Kuhawi kiekari warie memaketɨkɨ, Kuhawi timaitɨ hakewa memayenexɨanikekai waɨkawa memeuyutakwiwawe, 'Uriyaxi mana kaniutikeni.
Hikɨ kepauka mana kiekatari memayekɨ Kuhawi metamienike, hipatɨ Rawiri parewiwamete mekaniukwi'iwa, yaxeikɨata 'Uriyaxi heti tewiyari kaniumierieni.
Hikɨ Kuhawi Rawiri niuki kanenɨ'airieni naime hepaɨtsita rexaxatɨwatɨ kememɨteyutakwikai.
Mɨpaɨ katinihɨritɨani yuniuki tuayame: «Kepauka naime pemɨreitaxatɨani ti'aitame ketemɨteyutakwi hepaɨtsita,
xɨka mɨkɨ heyeha'ame mɨpaɨ meretahɨawe: “¿Titayari kwinimieme 'ahurawa xetehakɨ kiekari warita xewaretakwinike? ¿Xekatemaikai tamɨ kiekari kuraruyaritsie me'aka'utɨ memɨxetimɨnikekai?

¿Kemɨ'ane 'Awimereki pumi Yeruwetseti nu'aya? 'Ukaratsi katiniuyurieni wapaitɨ 'akawetɨ Tewetsi kuraruyari 'amatitewatsie teté titɨxɨme mahetekɨ mana kaneikatuaxa kɨmana kanimieni. ¿Ketitayari 'ahurawa xete'ukɨ 'ixumeri 'amatitewa hetɨa?” Xɨka mɨpaɨ mareta'iwawiya, mɨpaɨ ketinetahɨawita: “Metatsiere 'Uriyaxi heti tewiyari kanemierieni, 'ekɨ ti'aitame mati'uximayatsiriwame”».
Hikɨ Kuhawi niuki tuayameya kaneyani. 'Uta'aka yapauka Rawiri naime katiniutaxatɨani Kuhawi kemɨreitaxatɨakai.
Tewi niuki tuayame mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Kuyaxi memɨtatsi'aye'unie mekatana'iwarɨmekaitɨni, peru kepauka 'amakuyewatsie temu'axɨa tekaniwaranukuweiya kiekari kiteniepai tekaniwaye'atɨani.

Hikɨ temɨmɨmete wapaitɨ kurarutsie memaka'ukai 'akuyaxima mekaniwaretamɨni, hikɨ 'ana ta'iwama yayupaɨmetɨ mekanekwi'iwa. Yaxeikɨata 'Uriyaxi heti tewiyari kanemierieni, 'ekɨ ti'aitame mati'uximayatsiriwame.

Merikɨte Rawiri yuniuki tuayame mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Kuhawi mɨpaɨ ketinetahɨawi nehetsiemieme waɨkawa 'axapɨkareyɨkɨhɨaweni kemɨreyɨ hepaɨtsita, 'ixipara matsi pɨtiyumemiwa tsepa kemɨ'ane. Mɨpaɨ ketinetahɨawi tawarita hekwamekɨ kewaretakwini mana kiekatari, kepaukake mɨkɨ kiekari naime meka'una.
Kepauka Wetitsawe mɨtiutamari kename kɨnaya 'Uriyaxi hemieriekai, 'ana yuhiwerietɨ kanayani hetsiena mieme.
'Arike yuhiwerietɨ tiuhayewaku, Rawiri katiniutanɨ'ani paratsiyuta mɨ'atɨarienikɨ hikɨ kanitiwitɨni meta nunutsi kanayexeiya hetsiena mieme. Rawiri kemɨtiuyuri matsi Yawé pika'inakixɨ.
